problem_profile.summary: Use deepseek-v4-flash for W3 candidate-generation atoms while preserving independent verification and non-solving W3R rendering.
assumptions: teacher approval remains outside every model task
constraints: W3R cannot solve or retrieve solution evidence
a solver cannot be its own sole independent verifier
excluded_scope: Gold or Evidence promotion by a model

targets.description: Flash executes W3 candidate decomposition and solving through an auditable route.
success_criteria: Every model stage records provider, model, contract, input fingerprint and usage.

targets.description: No Flash-generated conclusion becomes verified through self-approval.
success_criteria: Critical claims have deterministic or different-model certificates.

targets.description: W3R improves presentation without changing the frozen W3 meaning.
success_criteria: All W3R fidelity gates pass and unsupported claim rate is zero.

nodes.label: W3R candidate reviewed
invariants: No new claim or changed condition
exit_conditions: Render gate and teacher review complete

atomic_tasks.description: Generate the W3 blueprint with Flash.
Generate the structured W3 solution with Flash.
Verify claims through deterministic checks and a different model identity where semantic review is required.
Aggregate claims and certificates into a proof package.
Project a verified proof package into the non-solving W3R brief.
Run paired evaluation, blind teacher review and fresh holdout before routing promotion.

state_transfers.invalidation_rule: Invalidate when approved-problem or mandatory source obligations change.
Invalidate when approved-problem, evidence-set, blueprint or model identity changes.

preconditions: A3 terminated without unsupported critical claims
state_transfers.invalidation_rule: Invalidate when a claim, claim version, verifier identity or verification input fingerprint changes.
Invalidate when any claim, certificate or obligation changes.
Invalidate when proof-package fingerprint changes; retry must reuse the identical brief fingerprint.
Invalidate when the brief, renderer identity, render output or gate report changes.

verification_obligations.claim: Flash calls are auditable and contract-bound.
verification_obligations.method: Compare stage route, model identity, contract and fingerprints.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: Every generated stage has a complete trace and valid output contract.

verification_obligations.claim: The solver did not self-approve its critical conclusions.
verification_obligations.method: Compare generator and verifier model identities and deterministic certificate coverage.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: Critical claims have a valid independent path and all obligations are closed.

verification_obligations.claim: W3R preserves answer meaning and improves teachability.
verification_obligations.method: Run fidelity gates, paired blind review and untouched holdout scoring.
verification_obligations.decision_rule: All hard fidelity metrics equal 1.0, unsupported claim rate is zero, readability preference exceeds 0.5 and edit rate does not regress.

allocation_notes: Claim batches may run with bounded concurrency, but no consumer starts before its producer passes.

aggregation.acceptance_rule: All critical obligations pass and each target has accepted evidence bound to the current fingerprints.
aggregation.conflict_policy: Use deterministic or independent decisive tests; never majority vote.
aggregation.unresolved_policy: Preserve conditions, mark provisional and stop production promotion.
